description: This file contains unit tests for the MembershipTableManager class in the Orleans cluster management system. It uses the Xunit testing framework along with NSubstitute for mocking dependencies. The tests cover various scenarios such as startup behaviors in different cluster states, handling of silo status transitions, split votes and consensus for declaring silos dead, refresh logic, and lifecycle participation.

classes.name: MembershipTableManagerTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests for the MembershipTableManager class, testing startup, status updates, suspicion/killing logic, refresh behaviors, and edge cases involving cluster state and clock synchronization.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_NewCluster
methods.description: Tests the behavior of MembershipTableManager when starting with a new cluster.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_ExistingCluster
methods.description: Tests the behavior of MembershipTableManager during startup when an existing cluster is detected.

methods.name: BasicScenarioTest
methods.description: Helper method that performs core tests of the membership management flow, including status transitions, table reads, and lifecycle participation.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_Restarted
methods.description: Tests handling of restart scenarios where a previous membership entry exists.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_Superseded
methods.description: Verifies that a silo declared superseded is handled correctly, typically leading to a fatal error.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_AlreadyDeclaredDead
methods.description: Tests behavior when a silo is already marked dead before startup.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_DeclaredDead_AfterJoining
methods.description: Tests behavior of a silo that marks itself dead after initially joining a cluster.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_TrySuspectOrKill_ButIAmKill
methods.description: Verifies that a silo does not kill itself when suspecting another silo, but kills a different one.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_TrySuspectOrKill_AlreadyDead
methods.description: Checks that trying to suspect an already dead silo does not change its state.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_TrySuspectOrKill_DeclareDead_SmallCluster
methods.description: Tests declaring a silo dead in a small 2-node cluster.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_TrySuspectOrKill_ClocksNotSynchronized
methods.description: Tests suspicion logic under large clock skew conditions to ensure consistency.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_TrySuspectOrKill_DeclareDead_LargerCluster
methods.description: Tests dead declaration in a larger cluster with multiple votes.

methods.name: MembershipTableManager_Refresh
methods.description: Tests the refresh behavior of the membership table, including retry logic after failures.
